s: Which numbered cave in Ajanta has the "Svetagaja Jataka" painting?

The Svetagaja (White Elephant) Jataka painting is found in Ajanta Cave No. 10. The Ajanta caves contain numerous Jataka stories, depicting the previous births of the Buddha through magnificent mural paintings. Cave 10 is one of the earliest Chaitya halls at Ajanta and preserves several important Buddhist paintings.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
